_comment: Semantic rules for Linux-to-FreeBSD NIC driver porting analysis. schema_version 3.3. All linux_api_patterns use prefix-anchored regex matched against symbol names. freebsd_target_hints are authoritative porting guidance. risk_weights are 1-5 (5 = highest porting risk). subsystem_patterns match against file/function names for subsystem classification.
external_unclassified_target_hint: Identify the target-native semantic equivalent; do not assume name-level equivalence. Verify execution context, sleepability, ownership, and lifetime before selecting a FreeBSD primitive.

freebsd_target_hints.atomics_bitops: FreeBSD atomic(9): atomic_load_int/atomic_store_int/atomic_add_int/atomic_cmpset_int and bitset(9). Verify width (32/64/ptr), signedness, and memory-order semantics explicitly. FreeBSD atomic_* are distinct from Linux atomic_t; do not assume name equivalence.
freebsd_target_hints.auxiliary_bus: No FreeBSD auxiliary bus equivalent. Linux auxiliary_device/auxiliary_driver is used for IDPF RDMA peer coordination (idc_rdma_*). Evaluate newbus child devices, explicit callback registration structs, or a driver-private peer-notification interface. Requires architecture decision and security review before porting. See idpf_scope_and_deferred_work: RDMA coordination is CONDITIONAL.
freebsd_target_hints.completion_wait: FreeBSD sleep/wakeup(9), msleep(9), cv(9) condvar, sx(9), or taskqueue_drain(9) selected by execution context and sleepability. MTX_DEF must not be held across a sleep. Reconstruct the predicate and wakeup ownership explicitly; do not mechanically map init_completion/wait_for_completion.
freebsd_target_hints.devmem_zero_copy: No assumed FreeBSD equivalent. Linux MSG_ZEROCOPY/io_uring/net_devmem paths have no direct FreeBSD mapping. Treat as ON_HOLD pending product owner, FreeBSD memory subsystem, and security owner decisions. Do not port without explicit architecture approval.
freebsd_target_hints.dma: FreeBSD bus_dma(9): bus_dma_tag_create, bus_dmamem_alloc, bus_dmamap_load, bus_dmamap_sync, bus_dmamap_unload, bus_dmamem_free, bus_dma_tag_destroy. Preserve DMA tag constraints (alignment, boundary, address width, segment count), sync direction (BUS_DMASYNC_PRE/POSTREAD/WRITE), ownership transfer, and reverse-unwind on error. Linux DMA_TO_DEVICE = BUS_DMASYNC_PREWRITE; DMA_FROM_DEVICE = BUS_DMASYNC_PREREAD. page_pool has no FreeBSD equivalent; use iflib buffer management or UMA.
freebsd_target_hints.endian_unaligned: Use FreeBSD le16toh/le32toh/le64toh/htole*/be*/bswap* from <sys/endian.h>. Verify descriptor, register, and wire-format byte order before substituting. get_unaligned/put_unaligned map to memcpy-based helpers; do not use pointer casts.
freebsd_target_hints.error_recovery_pci: FreeBSD PCI error recovery is bus-managed, not driver-callback-driven. Remove struct pci_error_handlers entirely. Rely on device_shutdown(9)/ifdi_suspend/ifdi_resume and reset detection via register polling (MMIO all-ones sentinel). pcie_capability_* maps to pci_find_extcap(9) + pci_read_config(9).
freebsd_target_hints.inline_crypto: No direct FreeBSD kernel crypto offload framework equivalent for xfrm/IPsec offload. Treat as ON_HOLD (feature 251 in architecture plan). Requires FreeBSD IPsec, security, and protocol owner decisions. Do not port xfrm_state or ipsec_offload_dev without explicit approval and threat review.
freebsd_target_hints.interrupt: FreeBSD PCI MSI/MSI-X: pci_alloc_msix(9), bus_alloc_resource(9), bus_setup_intr(9)/bus_teardown_intr(9), or iflib interrupt model. Preserve vector ownership, masking/unmasking, affinity, and quiesce-before-teardown rules. IRQF_* flags have no FreeBSD equivalent; model the behavior explicitly. irq_set_affinity_hint maps to bus_bind_intr(9).
freebsd_target_hints.logging_debug: FreeBSD device_printf(9), log(9), if_printf(9). Rate-limited logging: use a counter + periodic flush pattern. WARN_ON maps to KASSERT or explicit device_printf + return. BUG_ON maps to panic() only for invariant violations. Preserve operator-facing message content and severity.
freebsd_target_hints.memory: FreeBSD malloc(9) with M_NOWAIT/M_WAITOK/M_ZERO flags, contigmalloc(9) for physically contiguous, UMA(9) for per-object pools, or bus_dma-backed memory for DMA-visible allocations. Preserve allocation context (interrupt vs. process), alignment, blocking constraints, and lifetime. devm_* has no FreeBSD equivalent; use explicit release in detach error paths.
freebsd_target_hints.mmio_bus: FreeBSD bus_space(9): bus_space_read_4/bus_space_write_4 via resource-derived tag and handle, or bus_read_4/bus_write_4 on struct resource*. Preserve access width, ordering, barriers (bus_space_barrier), endianness, and posted-write flushing. __iomem is a Linux sparse annotation with no FreeBSD equivalent; remove it.
freebsd_target_hints.module_device_model: FreeBSD: DRIVER_MODULE(9), MODULE_DEPEND(9), MODULE_VERSION(9), device_method_t, driver_t, newbus probe/attach/detach/shutdown. iflib: IFLIB_PNP_INFO, iflib_device_attach/detach. THIS_MODULE has no equivalent; module reference counting uses modevent(9). devm_* has no equivalent.
freebsd_target_hints.napi_polling: FreeBSD iflib deferred processing replaces NAPI entirely. napi_schedule maps to iflib TX/RX queue callbacks invoked by the taskqueue. napi_complete_done maps to iflib re-arm. napi_gro_receive maps to iflib RX packet delivery. Do not implement a NAPI emulation layer.
freebsd_target_hints.netstack: FreeBSD iflib/ifnet/mbuf model. struct net_device -> struct ifnet (managed by iflib). struct sk_buff -> struct mbuf. netif_receive_skb -> iflib RX callback chain. netif_carrier_on/off -> if_link_state_change(9). netdev_priv -> iflib_get_softc(). NETDEV_TX_OK -> 0; NETDEV_TX_BUSY -> ENOBUFS. Translate packet ownership, offload metadata, and completion semantics; do not port Linux helper names.
freebsd_target_hints.pci: FreeBSD newbus/PCI: pci_find_cap(9), bus_alloc_resource_any(9), bus_release_resource(9), pci_enable_busmaster(9), pci_get_vendor/device/subvendor/subdevice/revid(9). BAR mapping: bus_alloc_resource_any with SYS_RES_MEMORY + RF_ACTIVE. MSI-X: pci_alloc_msix(9). pci_set_drvdata/get_drvdata -> softc pointer via iflib_get_softc(). PCI_DEVICE macro -> PVID() in iflib.
freebsd_target_hints.ptp_timestamping: FreeBSD has no ptp_clock_register equivalent in the base kernel. sysctl-based PHC exposure (as in idpf_ptp_sysctl_clock) is the current approach. SO_TIMESTAMPING has no FreeBSD equivalent. ktime_t maps to sbintime_t or uint64_t nanoseconds. timecounter/cyclecounter have partial equivalents in <sys/timecounter.h>. Treat full PTP stack integration as CONDITIONAL pending FreeBSD time-stack owner decision.
freebsd_target_hints.rcu: Evaluate FreeBSD epoch(9)/NET_EPOCH, refcount(9), or lock-based redesign. Do not mechanically map rcu_read_lock/rcu_dereference. epoch_enter/epoch_exit replaces rcu_read_lock/unlock for network paths. kfree_rcu maps to epoch_call or explicit free after synchronization. synchronize_rcu maps to epoch_wait.
freebsd_target_hints.sync_locking: FreeBSD mtx(9)/sx(9)/rwlock(9)/epoch(9)/critical_enter(9) chosen by execution context and sleepability. MTX_DEF for non-sleepable; sx for sleepable (e.g. mailbox paths). spinlock_t -> struct mtx with MTX_SPIN. mutex -> struct mtx MTX_DEF or struct sx. completion -> cv(9) + mtx. DEFINE_MUTEX -> MTX_DEF + mtx_init. Preserve invariants and lock ordering; WITNESS(4) enforces total order.
freebsd_target_hints.timer_time: FreeBSD callout(9) replaces struct timer_list. callout_init_mtx/callout_reset/callout_drain. pause(9)/DELAY(9)/tsleep(9) replace msleep/usleep_range/udelay. jiffies -> ticks; HZ -> hz; msecs_to_jiffies -> idpf_msecs_to_ticks(). ktime_t -> sbintime_t or uint64_t ns. hrtimer has no direct equivalent; use callout with fine-grained tick resolution.
freebsd_target_hints.userspace_config: Translate to FreeBSD ifconfig(8)/ifmedia(4)/sysctl(9)/ioctl(9)/devctl(4) facilities. ethtool -> sysctl nodes + ifmedia. devlink -> sysctl. debugfs/sysfs/procfs -> sysctl. DEVICE_ATTR -> SYSCTL_ADD_*. Do not emulate ethtool/devlink/sysfs/debugfs interfaces.
freebsd_target_hints.work_async: FreeBSD taskqueue(9)/grouptask(9)/callout(9)/ithread. INIT_WORK+queue_work -> TASK_INIT+taskqueue_enqueue. INIT_DELAYED_WORK+schedule_delayed_work -> callout_reset to enqueue a task. cancel_work_sync -> taskqueue_drain (after stopping the enqueue source). destroy_workqueue -> taskqueue_free (after drain). kthread_* -> kthread_add(9) or dedicated taskqueue thread. Reconstruct async state machine and drain semantics before selecting primitives.
freebsd_target_hints.xdp_xsk: No assumed 1:1 FreeBSD equivalent. XDP/AF_XDP is ON_HOLD (feature 255 in architecture plan). Treat as redesign requiring product owner, FreeBSD framework owner, IOMMU boundary, and security review decisions. Linux XDP helpers (xdp_buff, xdp_frame, bpf_prog_*) have no FreeBSD kernel equivalents. Do not port without explicit architecture approval.
